title: Dumbbell Only, Full Body, 3x Week
author: Bhavin S.
desc: Transform your physique with this comprehensive 18-week program designed exclusively for dumbbell training. Targeting your entire body, this routine is structured for five days a week, ensuring balanced muscle engagement and optimal recovery. Each session is crafted to build strength, enhance endurance, and sculpt your physique, making it perfect for lifters of all levels. Embrace the simplicity and effectiveness of dumbbells to unlock your full potential!
